title: The tech story check mark no longer shows on work order lines
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  3. A user whose role uses the Tech View work order mode from Roles & Permissions (e.g. a "Technician" role, Settings > Roles & Permissions > the role's work order view mode), signed in in a second browser. This is the Simple Flow tech view mode, not the Tech View display on the Work Orders page.
  4. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  5. Create an Approved work order for the case customer with a line "Line 1" and enter a tech story on it (e.g. "Brought unit in. Completed inspection.").
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order and click the Lines tab.
  2. Look at Line 1's Story row and the line row for a check mark.
  3. In the second browser (Tech View work order mode) open the same work order and look at Line 1 again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Line 1 shows its story text with no check-mark indicator anywhere on the line, on the normal work order page and in the Simple Flow tech view mode.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10051 (Story 8, Remove the tech story check-mark indicator); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S8-R1, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html) work order page (wo-details/Add Part.html): Story row shows only the text. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “The check-mark indicator that appears on a work order line when a tech story has been entered is removed everywhere it appears (work order page line list, including the Simple Flow tech view mode).”
